evidence: Source/arithmetic portion is supported, but required empirical ranking is absent. Frozen scoring.toml:1-11 assigns zero gate mass, positive functional/polish/visual shares 0.6/0.2/0.2 and functional floor 0.05; these and score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template. score.py:40-48 applies gates/floor before the positive weighted result, so increasing an observed dimension cannot lower reward. Parsed functional weights are all positive (145 criteria, total45), polish has4 criteria totaling9, and visual has5 totaling6. Direct execution with python -B of evidence/42/check_score_monotonicity.py exercised448 synthetic dimension tuples and1504 adjacent coordinate increases with zero inversions. Synthetic all-full input returns1; identical synthetic input with only hro_change_aba weight2/45 denied returns0.9733. These are synthetic arithmetic results, not app grades. Gate criteria demand authentication plus new requisition/offer creation and independent-context readback, and explicitly allow empty operational collections and alternate UI/schema choices; functional/prompt.md:11 preserves independent observations instead of inheriting sibling failure. Raw gate-witness/results.json (SHA256 fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75) records golden and dead_approval satisfying the minimal creation witness while no_op_create fails. Raw batch-witnesses/results.json (477ba650c81ce00e5d6346f679b774f23c5a197b78b346bb183e7eb0a70bcf83) records golden and empty_operational_seed passing15 scripted groups, while balance_only_version, no_cached_receipt and sequential_budget fail targeted groups; it explicitly disclaims configured scores/order. Raw partial-recovery/results.json (05925669dec02a71b184b7fbf9970ae86980dbc4b8a1bc664344ba7c906c7f9b) shows a broken ABA implementation still retaining editor recovery, a meaningful partial-quality comparison requiring independent credit. Uncached configured-inspection/results.json (846bbc329dd21dae7950550587f858211460d50d6820ae5b459b52f38449b808) explicitly contains parser/schema/CLI construction and NO provider grade. Verified all4 cited indexed artifact hashes plus all15 tests_sha256 bindings against current frozen bytes; hash-verification.json records19 matches. The current index explicitly says full configured reward comparison is absent, and runtime-evidence.json does not exist. Policy requires a separately hash-bound real reward-ordering observation; targeted behavior logs and scorer fixtures cannot supply it. Therefore no measured application-level inversion is claimed, but row42 cannot pass.
counterexample: Assessed broken/conforming alternatives, not a measured inversion: balance_only_version wrongly accepts a restored-balance ABA commit (raw200 versus required409) while retaining usable editor recovery; a correct empty-operational-seed implementation is expressly allowed by instruction.md:11 and passes all15 scripted batch groups. The gate text tolerates that conforming alternative and the dedicated ABA criterion has positive weight, so no source-supported inversion was established. A configured comparison must demonstrate that the weaker ABA implementation does not outrank its otherwise equivalent correct version and that empty operational history does not wrongly zero the conforming alternative. Dead approval can pass the intended minimal creation gate; its final functional/floor outcome was never measured.
suggested_fix: With existing provider authorization, run the unchanged configured judge on the exact candidate and controlled weaker/conforming variants, retain per-criterion and final rewards plus logs, and add the current-input-bound reward_ranking_is_monotone runtime record; fix any observed inversion in a new candidate without changing shared scoring policy to silence the result.
